summary: Getting Renewable and Energy Efficient Neighborhoods Appraisals Act of 2025 or the GREEN Appraisals Act of 2025 This bill requires lenders that originate federally backed residential mortgages to notify borrowers of their right to request an energy report concerning the property. The bill also requires, upon consent of the borrower, the lender to provide to an appraiser any available energy report concerning the property. The appraiser must take this report into consideration when appraising the value of the property.
